## `#else`

The `#else` directive can be added to a conditional to provide alternative text to be used if the condition fails. If the expression in the opening `#if` (or `#ifdef`/`#ifndef`) is nonzero, the text before `#else` is included and the text after is skipped. If the expression is zero, the opposite happens.

You can use `#else` with `#ifdef` and `#ifndef`, too.
